objective: Determine whether the user-uploaded dungeon.zip supplies the room-ID-to-scene crosswalk needed to reconcile analyzer parent groups with static CARGO_FLOATERS room rules.

archive.archive_read_validation: All 2866 file entries were read successfully; no extraction or execution performed.
archive.path_validation: Entries are under the dungeon asset tree; no absolute or parent-traversal paths were used.

scans.patterns: R_*/B_* room IDs, RoomId, DungeonOptions, DungeonRootScene

archive.conclusion: The uploaded dungeon.zip is a model/scene asset archive and does not contain an explicit scene-path-to-static-RoomId crosswalk.

latest_pointer_report.authority_note: This combined report is the sole source used for results of its run; queue.jsonl and separate per-action latest files were not substituted.

historical_cargo_report.finding: Historical CARGO_FLOATERS report: 8 CARG-dominant + 2 BARRACKS-dominant + 1 END-dominant analyzer parent-key groups (11 total); 43 targets are asset-derived predictions (30 salvage + 13 footlockers across 164 resolved scenes), not observed container counts.

dungeon_c_evidence.finding: The separately recorded 11-room traverse contains no per-room RoomId mapping.

conclusion: The new ZIP does not change the room-count reconciliation: asset families and filenames are present, but the archive contains no RoomId or R_*/B_* labels in readable or binary entries. Analyzer parent-key groups therefore still cannot be matched to static room IDs. Do not equate 11 CARGO groups with seven static Rooms; do not treat 43 or 14 predicted targets as observed counts.

human_intervention.request: Provide an artifact that explicitly pairs at least one captured dungeon scene path with its static RoomId (R_* or B_*), or its exact accessible repository path. The uploaded dungeon.zip was checked and does not contain that mapping; do not upload it again.

rollback.revert: Revert the publication commit to remove this review and the associated lane/shared-state text; keep dungeon.zip and historical reports.
